text:
morgan: FYI seeing a spike of 503s for short embeddings (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 starting ~02:10 UTC. p99 errors up ~3%. Suspect yesterday's quant kernel. Preparing revert to redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Need fast approvals to deploy in the window.

liam: customer impact?

morgan: limited subset of calls, ~3% traffic; a couple support tickets. No schema/db changes.

sara: any cache or migration needed?

morgan: recommend draining prefix cache after deploy; no data migration.

morgan: deploy request: /deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix --strategy canary=5%:3m (skip-canary allowed with unanimous approval) --reason "short-embed 503 regression"

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6378901234 created. Approvals required: eng-leads (liam,sara) + ops-oncall (dave-ops). Preflight: integration-tests PASS, smoke WARNING (503 observed).

dave-ops: Oncall here. I can approve if we do 5% canary 3m then evaluate. I'll monitor.

liam: approving for eng if dave watches. /approve 6378901234

sara: approving for docs/QA; I'll draft support note. /approve 6378901234

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: liam, sara, dave-ops. Starting canary 5% (180s). Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6378901234

morgan: running drain then kubectl set image: `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu`

deploy-bot: Canary healthy; errors in new pods 0, latency stable. dave-ops: canary green, ramping to 25% for 4m.

deploy-bot: 25% complete, metrics healthy (errors <0.1%). Rolling to 100% now. Deploy complete. Healthchecks PASS.

morgan: drained prefix cache and warmed. No regressions in 10m post-deploy.

liam: Add release note: "Embeddings: hotfix revert to v2.3.2 to address 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1; canary ramp and prefix cache drain performed."

sara: support blurb sent.

morgan: will follow up with RCA on quant kernel. Closing when notes posted. :white_check_mark:
